info.title: YouPoisk current runtime API
info.description: Partial implemented MVP contract:17business operations plus2health operations, not the full planned product. Standard JSON bodies8KiB, exact origins, access in memory, credentials/secrets never in URLs/logs/YouTube DOM. Database schema remains Go Code First; this external IDL is checked against actual Go route registrations and DTO responses. Int64 clients must reject unsafe numeric values rather than silently round. Mail and browser-broker protocols are not advertised as implemented.

post.summary: Rotate or recover one refresh attempt
post.description: Web requires exactly one HttpOnly cookie and forbids JSON refresh_token, includingnull. Extension requires explicit body token and pinned client type. Persist attempt_id/proof and reuse after uncertain outcomes; old-parent/child retries recover same child. 409 refresh_advanced never sets an older cookie; 503/network failure does not force login. Unknown consumed reuse revokes the family. Do not begin a new attempt until pending state is reconciled.

post.summary: Change password and revoke every device
post.description: 422 incorrect_current_password or invalid_new_password preserves active session. Success atomically changes salted hash and revokes all families including caller; new login required. No client password persistence/offline retry; reconcile uncertain response through a new login. Shared KDF/admission with login; no email recovery.

post.summary: Observe metadata and add a video atomically
post.description: Always added=true, optional rating/later. Unknown ID does not require a prior catalog write. One transaction covers global upsert/provisional metadata, expected personal state, event and receipt. Untrusted input cannot overwrite known/trusted metadata, promote UC or bind global handles. No categories/caller URLs/source/trust fields.30tags/input,100global bounded additive union; excess metadata does not lose core add. Writeack is not a pull cursor.

title.description: Optional observed plain text; server NFC/whitespace-normalizes to at most250 code points, raw UTF8 bound4096bytes. Empty/null means unknown, not a fabricated title.

youtube_channel_id.description: Optional UC claim, not trusted identity/membership evidence.

channel_name.description: Optional observed plain name, normalized max150 code points.

channel_handle.description: Observed bounded handle text only; never an identity/merge key or a fetch URL.

duration_seconds.description: Unknown staysnull and is hidden by clients.

items.description: Optional leading#, then Unicode letters/numbers/marks/underscore. Server NFC+casefold, normalized1..100 code points; raw input at most1024bytes.

hashtags_observation_status.description: Omitted/null meansunknown. Unknown cannot carry positive tags. Complete empty is observed empty; untrusted input never grants erasure authority.

expected_revision.description: JSON int64. JavaScript clients must reject unsafe integers rather than round a revision or sequence.

count.description: JSON int64. JavaScript clients must reject unsafe integers rather than round a revision or sequence.

average.description: Real sum/count, exact positive half-up to2decimal places. Count0 givesnull, never a synthetic score.

association_verified.description: Separate video provider proof. Verified channel alone is insufficient. Future context writes recheck proof server-side.

my_state.description: Omitted for guest; only current live viewer, never another author. Absent carrier means real revision0.

Idempotency.name: Idempotency-Key
Idempotency.description: Stable UUID for the exact immutable queued body; scope is account+operation/target.

Lease.name: X-Offline-Lease
Lease.description: Required on fresh personal writes; exact authorized receipt replay is checked first and may succeed without a new lease.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Exact allowlisted browser origin; web credential requests require a web origin. Extension mode accepts its exact origin or no Origin from a nonbrowser caller.

Bearer.description: Signature/issuer/audience/expiry and current DB session are validated server-side.

WebRefreshCookie.name: __Host-yp_refresh
WebRefreshCookie.description: Production web only. Dev cookieyp_refresh_dev. Conditional alternative: trusted extension body refresh_token, never a website token store.

x-deferred-modules.name: email
x-deferred-modules.reason: Explicit user deferral: no SMTP/verification/forgot/reset runtime routes or fake email success UI.

x-unimplemented-release-gates: First-party browser broker/PKCE and real blocked-third-party-cookie proof
Catalog lists/search, own lists, privacy/social/posts/DM/moderation/full sync
x-runtime-method-policy: Explicit operations listed only. Go GET also handles HEAD; browser CORS OPTIONS and JSON method fallbacks are transport behavior, not hidden product endpoints.
